title: Robbing A Bank Vault In GTA 6
yt_title: Rob A Bank Vault In GTA 6 = Instant 4 Stars 🚔 #shorts
description:
Store robberies can pay $10,000 to $25,000 each, but robbing a bank vault in GTA 6 instantly triggers a four-star wanted level.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA6Money

lines.text: Want fast money in GTA 6? Robberies are the move.
Some robberies pay ten to twenty five thousand each.
Chain a few together and you're rich fast.
But a bank vault? That's an instant four star wanted level.
So plan your escape before you touch that vault.
And remember, deposit the cash after.
Banks or stores, what's your move?
